job_description: Develop Python applications and REST APIs. Work with SQL databases, Git version control, testing and debugging.
Analyze datasets using Python, SQL and Excel. Build dashboards in Power BI and communicate statistical insights.
Prepare data and build machine learning models using Python, pandas and scikit-learn. Evaluate model performance.
Build responsive web interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React. Collaborate using Git.

Create reports and dashboards, query business data using SQL and present insights using BI tools.
Experiment with computer vision and deep learning workflows using Python, TensorFlow and NumPy.
